property_summary: After a call to collectDrugs(address(0)) from address(1) with no prior referral, the reference sets referral to address(0) while the bug sets it to msg.sender, so address(0) gets a referral bonus in the reference but not in the bug.
change_summary: Change the referral assignment so that it always sets the referral to the caller (msg.sender) instead of the provided address.
